in_marathi.name: Pradipkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pradipkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Pradi' meaning 'before' and 'Deep' meaning 'lamp' or 'light'. The name signifies the one who carries the light of knowledge before him, illuminating the path for others.
